initial_conditions: Packaged Debian ARM64 studio on the original shirt, focused X11 window with Vulkan software rendering.
actions: Send Ctrl+K and Escape to the focused X11 window using XTEST. Capture each visible state.
Close the native window normally and compare the editable file digest.
expected_outcomes: The toolbar shows Ctrl+K. The palette appears after Ctrl+K and disappears after Escape. The normal close exits successfully and preserves the editable file.
